acceptance: Tests show red_streak_start reports the culprit as undetermined while an older develop Trunk run is still in progress, and the arm gate and trunk-revert handle that state without naming or reverting a commit
site-inputs.yml never lets an older commit's run displace a newer one (test or workflow pin)
context:
Merged: PR 3613 (7334472f1). red_streak_start raises UndeterminedCulpritError while an older develop Trunk run is unfinished; the arm gate, status and trunk-revert refuse without naming or reverting a commit; the disarm workflow disarms armed non-revert PRs in that state. site-inputs.yml uses queue: max (already used by trunk.yml), pinned by a workflow test. Not verified on live Actions; queue: max was checked against the documentation only.

Source: Trunk queue study on trunk-serial-queue-latency-20261025 (2026-10-25). Do not start unless that item's owner decision approves concurrent Trunk runs.
description: Prerequisite for any change that lets more than one Trunk run go at once. red_streak_start (used by culprit naming, the arm gate and trunk-revert) skips unfinished runs, so with concurrent runs a newer commit can be named as culprit while an older run is still in progress; it should report the culprit as undetermined until every older run has finished. site-inputs.yml keeps only one pending run, so an older commit's trigger can displace a newer one when runs complete out of order; it needs queue: max or an ancestry check. The work is only needed if the owner approves Trunk lanes after re-measuring the queue.
